SELECT c.id, c.record_id, c.field_id, c.value_text, c.value_number, c.value_date, c.value_json, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM `bitable_cell_values` c INNER JOIN `bitable_records` r ON r.id = c.record_id AND r.deleted_at = 0 WHERE c.field_id = #{fieldId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `bitable_cell_values` (record_id, field_id, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_json) VALUES (#{cell.recordId}, #{cell.fieldId}, #{cell.valueText}, #{cell.valueNumber}, #{cell.valueDate}, #{cell.valueJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_text = #{cell.valueText}, value_number = #{cell.valueNumber}, value_date = #{cell.valueDate}, value_json = #{cell.valueJson}, updated_at = NOW()
